mapper.select: SELECT job_id FROM afv_media_preview_current WHERE source_resource_id = #{sourceId} AND source_version = #{version} AND profile = #{profile} FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.source_resource_id, p.source_version, j.project_id FROM afv_media_preview_job p JOIN afv_media_job j ON j.id = p.job_id JOIN afv_media_preview_current c ON c.job_id = p.job_id AND c.source_resource_id = p.source_resource_id AND c.source_version = p.source_version AND c.profile = p.profile WHERE p.job_id = #{jobId} AND j.kind = 'MEDIA_PREVIEW' AND p.profile = #{profile}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_media_preview_current(source_resource_id, source_version, profile, job_id, updated_at) VALUES (#{sourceId}, #{version}, #{profile}, #{jobId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE job_id = VALUES(job_id), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
